saw_lines: Furniture buyers worry about how a big piece arrives before style. Damage and wait times decide whether they order.
So the sale is lost in the first seconds, when no delivery promise shows before the buyer scrolls past.
Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads mention delivery. Shoot one video of a box arriving and the chair unpacked, and open with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site explains how the furniture arrives, yet 0 of 30 ads mention delivery. Buyers worry about damage before they click, so the ad loses them. Shoot one video of a box arriving and the chair unpacked, and open with it.

0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no sign others already trust the brand. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next creative with it.

4 of 30 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the person talking about the chair reads like an ad. Whitelist those 4 posts from each creator’s own account, then test variations with new first lines against them.
9 of 30 copy ads open on one line, let your space do the talking, so buyers see the same hook. Test two new opening angles against it, such as a room before and after, and keep the stronger one.
